description: This file defines the AttributesDao interface for data access operations related to attributes in the Thingsboard platform, including methods for finding, saving, and removing attribute entries, as well as retrieving keys and latest attribute data.

classes.name: AttributesDao
classes.description: Interface defining data access methods for attribute entities, including find, save, remove, and key retrieval operations.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieve an attribute entry by tenant, entity, scope, and key.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieve multiple attribute entries by tenant, entity, scope, and a collection of keys.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieve all attribute entries for a given tenant, entity, and scope.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Remove multiple attribute entries by keys asynchronously.

methods.name: removeAllWithVersions
methods.description: Remove attribute entries with version info asynchronously.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieve the next batch of attribute entities based on entity ID, type, key, and batch size.

methods.name: findAllKeysByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Retrieve all attribute keys associated with a device profile.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieve all attribute keys for a list of entity IDs.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAndScope
methods.description: Retrieve attribute keys for multiple entities filtered by scope.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAndScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieve attribute keys for multiple entities filtered by scope.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAndScope
methods.description: Retrieve latest attribute entries for multiple entities filtered by scope.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAndScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieve latest attribute entries for multiple entities filtered by scope.

methods.name: removeAllByEntityId
methods.description: Remove all attribute entries associated with a specific entity ID.
